Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning code enforcement of storage facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to code enforcement of storage facilities; andadding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Zoning, building, and fire regulations must be enforced onunlicensed and improperly located storage facilities when the existenceof the facility becomes known and not just when a complaint is made. (2) The counties must use money collected from fines fornoncompliance with county zoning, building, and fire regulations toinvestigate instances of violations by selfstorage facilities. Theseinspections must be performed during regular, ongoing zoning, building,and fire regulation inspections.
